title: Sherlock Holmes: A Study in Scarlet — Ep 01/14 — "You Have Been in Afghanistan, I Perceive"
description:
A Study in Scarlet, Episode 1. London, 1881: an army surgeon invalided home from Afghanistan wants cheap rooms, and a friend from Barts knows a man who wants someone to go halves.

Told in Watson's own voice, cut to two and a half minutes. Stamford warns him at the Criterion bar that the man is a little too scientific, that it approaches to cold-bloodedness, and then walks him into the chemical laboratory at St Bartholomew's anyway. Holmes has one sentence ready for him, and Watson has not said a word about Afghanistan.

SOURCE
"A Study in Scarlet" by Arthur Conan Doyle, first published 1887. This episode adapts Chapter I, "Mr. Sherlock Holmes". The book is in the public domain. Full text from Project Gutenberg: https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/244

HOW THIS WAS MADE
Every picture and every voice in this video is generated with AI. The words are adapted from Arthur Conan Doyle's text and edited by a person; the narration is a synthetic voice, not a recording of anyone; no shot is footage of a real person, a real place or a real event. This video is also declared as altered or synthetic content in YouTube's own disclosure field.

THE SERIES
Fourteen chapters, fourteen episodes, in order.
